mostWorthwhile.text: Building the position information route and connecting it to the arm was most worthwhile: it linked a familiar ability to sensors in muscles and a returning nerve signal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the visual route and then the motor nerves was clear, but felt somewhat procedural because the next connection was repeatedly apparent.

surprise.text: The segmented support-cell wrapping, with gaps between segments, added detail to my understanding of insulated nerve fibers.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals gave each connection a recognizable purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting sensing, control and movement gave me a clear reason to be curious about how the body keeps the arm supplied during activity.
